subject: POC capacity planning / reserved GPUs & autoscale (EnterpriseX)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: John Doe <john.doe@enterprisex.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@enterprisex.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: POC capacity planning (EnterpriseX)

Hi John / Priya 	6

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have shared ownership for the POC planning: 

1) Success criteria (confirmed on call):
   - <70ms 95th percentile latency for short-chat flows (~64 token responses)
   - 95% request completion during simulated peak (200 rps sustained, 1k rps bursts)
   - Model quality parity (BLEU/ROUGE checks + manual eval pass) for the two core intents

2) Evaluation plan & timeline: 
   - Week 0 (this week): Exchange dataset samples + usage profile (Priya to send) 	6 ACTION: Priya
   - Week 1: Redwood to configure POC environment and reserved capacity; basic smoke tests 	6 OWNER: Marissa
   - Week 2: Load testing and quality evals; iterate kernels/quantization if needed 	6 OWNER: Vivek
   - Week 3: Final validation with customer traffic replay; decision point for expansion 	6 OWNER: Rishi + John

3) Capacity ask (we discussed rough numbers on the call):
   - Reserved GPUs for baseline: 4 x A100-80GB (predictable latency for baseline traffic)
   - Autoscale policy: allow burst to 12 GPUs for short periods (up to 10 minutes) with burst throttling/pacing
   - KV/prefix cache enabled for replay workloads to reduce per-token cost

4) Next steps:
   - Priya: Send sample traffic and test queries by EOD Thursday (2026-08-27)
   - Marissa: Share formal SOW + reserved capacity pricing and a proposed autoscale policy by Friday
   - Vivek: Prepare initial GPU config and expected throughput numbers for the above profile

Attachments: I'm attaching the draft SOW and a simple workbook to capture traffic metrics (EnterpriseX_Metrics.xlsx).

Thanks 	6 I'll follow up with the SOW and clear owners/timelines.


Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: John Doe <john.doe@enterprisex.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@enterprisex.com>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@enterprisex.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: POC capacity planning (EnterpriseX)

Marissa 	6

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few items from our side:

- We'll own sending the sample traffic plus mapping to intents (Priya will share the data). ETA Thu EOD.
- The success criteria look right. One ask: can you also include a tail-latency SLO (99th percentile) target? We want to understand worst-case user experience.
- For reserved GPUs, 4 x A100 sounds OK as a starting point. We expect typical baseline to be around 150 rps with occasional peaks up to ~900 rps (internal burst windows).

On autoscaling: we prefer burst capacity to be available but capped by spend. Can you include a hard cap and a manual approval step when projected costs exceed the baseline by >20%?

Also, would you be able to provide an estimate of token cost and projected spend over the 3-week trial with the numbers above? That will help us get internal signoff.

Appreciate it 	6 we're excited to move forward.

John
Head of Product | EnterpriseX
john.doe@enterprisex.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: John Doe <john.doe@enterprisex.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@enterprisex.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 27 Aug 2026 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: POC capacity planning (EnterpriseX)

Thanks John 	6 great points. See responses inline and an updated proposal below.

- Tail latency SLO: we'll target 99th percentile <200ms for the short-chat flows. We'll include both 95/99 metrics in the POC dashboard.
- Autoscale & cost control: we'll configure autoscaling that permits bursts up to 12 GPUs for up to 10 minutes per burst window, with a hard spend cap tied to the POC budget. If projected spend for the next 24h crosses baseline +20%, the system will flag and require manual approval from an assigned EnterpriseX approver.
- Token cost estimate (rough): based on 150 rps baseline, 64-token average response, 3-week duration with 12-hour daily activity window, estimated token usage ~25M tokens. At our trial pricing that maps to approximately $6,500 for tokens + $4,000 reserved GPU baseline + possible $2,000 for burst usage if fully exercised. I'll include a detailed cost table in the SOW.

Updated capacity proposal (for SOW):
- Reserved: 4 x A100-80GB (baseline) 	6 expected sustained throughput: ~180 rps with ~64-token avg
- Autoscale: up to 12 x A100 for bursts (10-minute windows), cooldown 5 min, backpressure enabled
- Networking & region: us-west1 (closer to EnterpriseX users)
- KV cache and batching: enabled for replay traffic; expected 20-30% token reduction on replay
- Owners: Redwood infra lead (Vivek) for config and Rishi for load testing/validation; Marissa will be commercial owner for SOW/approvals.

Next steps:
- I'll upload the SOW and cost table to the Drive link and share the DocuSign by EOD.
- Vivek, can you confirm the expected requests/sec per GPU and any other config notes?


Marissa

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: John Doe <john.doe@enterprisex.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@enterprisex.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: POC capacity planning (EnterpriseX)

Marissa / team 	6

Quick internal note and confirmation for the SOW:

- Perf estimates (short-chat flows, ~64 tokens): 1 A100-80GB ~= 45-50 rps with default quantization; with light-opt kernels and batching we can push ~60 rps while keeping 95th pct latency under 70ms.
- With 4 GPUs baseline we're ~240 rps peak sustained, which gives room vs their 150 rps baseline. Burst to 12 GPUs @ 60 rps each yields ~720 rps (aligned with their ~900 rps bursts if caching/prefix reuse applied).
- Autoscale policy implementable in Redwood Dedicated: we'll set burst duration to 10 minutes, cooldown 5 minutes. We'll instrument cost projection alerts and integrate a manual approval webhook for EnterpriseX when threshold exceeded.
- Ops checklist: init cluster, deploy model artifact (v1.2) with KV cache, run synthetic replay, then run customer traffic replay on Week 2.

I'll attach a short perf note and the expected dashboard metrics to the Drive folder (Perf_Note_EnterpriseX.pdf).

Vivek
Senior Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai
